north_star: Produce a coherent, intelligent Ninereeds core educated through preschool and K-8 knowledge, able to learn through chat, identify its own knowledge gaps, retrieve or commission suitable material, and ask the operator only when the pipeline genuinely requires human authority or physical intervention.

stage_objectives.commissioning: Establish a structurally healthy, reproducible full-core checkpoint.
stage_objectives.foundational_bootstrap: Accumulate broad full-core language foundations without mistaking immature generated behavior for a mature admission gate.
stage_objectives.language_stabilization: Develop coherent, prompt-sensitive language while protecting numerical and representational health.
stage_objectives.concept_learning: Build an ordered preschool-to-K-8 curriculum with transfer, retention, correction, uncertainty, and multilingual grounding.
stage_objectives.continual_research: Diagnose knowledge gaps, retrieve or commission evidence, learn through chat, and improve without regressing protected capabilities.

human_escalation_conditions: Physical intervention is required, such as a hard reboot, cabling, power, cooling, storage replacement, or other hands-on machine work.
A secret, account approval, legal choice, purchase, or new external authority is required.
A safety invariant cannot be preserved autonomously.
The same infrastructure blocker survives three bounded repair campaigns and no safe automated alternative remains.
routine_non_blockers: A campaign budget or wall-clock window ended.
Generated chat is incoherent during foundational bootstrap.
An executor response or script fails validation and can be repaired within existing authority.
A checkpoint is rejected while a certified rollback or developmental parent exists.
Additional curriculum material can be retrieved from the repository or commissioned through configured providers.
